title: Constructibility modulo an ideal propagates from the first reduction to all powers
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if the first reduction K tensor Lambda/I of a complex over the pro-etale site is bounded above with constructible cohomology, then so is every reduction modulo a power of the ideal (statement lines 5620-5628). The proof (proof lines 5630-5648) uses the distinguished triangle comparing successive reductions, identifies the third term as a tensor product of the first reduction, and runs an induction using the Serre subcategory properties of constructible complexes. H2: a two-step reduction with three inputs, written out in full.
